generation.scope: Near the rational point of the even-symmetric divisor the full center is a flat weighted (2,4) complete intersection. The determinant of Sym^2 Z4 -> Z8 cuts out the divisor with multiplicity one. On it the center is a double cover of a quadric branched in a quartic; off it the fifth quartic generator gives a quartic hypersurface. All fibers near the divisor are standard AS regular, geometrically normal central orders of PI degree 16.

proof_review.scope: Checked unit pivot transfer of the transverse derivative, sign decomposition, the direct summand of the center, weighted presentation, and the proper plane section.

mathematical_computation.scope: Reversal eigenspaces and multiplication in paths through length nine; filtered central fibers through length sixteen; smooth conic with eight transverse branch points; nonzero transverse derivative over Z/1009^2.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Classify minimum-dimensional simple modules of the PI order over the punctured center and their central characters, and implement a finite AS test for central-finite boundary charts.
